name: @astragate-community/middleware-model-map
description: New API's model_mapping (模型重定向) as magpie gateway middleware: send the model an agent asks for as another, and keep the asked name in replies

summary.en: New API's model redirection: send a model under another name, by name or pattern; replies keep the name asked for.
summary.zh: New API 的模型重定向：按名称或正则把模型换成另一个发出，回复里仍是原来的名字。
